commands.check: Original check_source.py and test_package.py from genuine prior recipe; do not skipcheck or modify recipe inputs
commands.native_build: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1793145600 PKGDEST=/tmp/security-prior-build SRCDEST=/tmp/security-prior-build BUILDDIR=/tmp/security-prior-build makepkg --check --cleanbuild --nosign --noconfirm --config <same pinned security-makepkg.conf>

compatibility.user_state: Package owns no user operation/cache paths. Existing runtime identity/pinned absolute paths may require fresh operation after upgrade; preserve old receipts and reject stale admissions rather than rewrite them.

optional: docker for explicit reviewed offline execution only

limits: Genuine retained earlier development candidate; not a published release or previous native-qualified version.
Retained host archive must not be installed on ARM; build original recipe natively in actual prior stage.
No package check skipped; actual transaction must use new native-built prior and candidate archives and scoped TEST signatures.
One package candidate transition does not establish M9, broad system upgrade/recovery, production trust or M2 support.

retained_host_archive.evidence_scope: Historical x86_64 host-assembled package only; not native accepted baseline; do not install it in native test

provenance.source_commit_scope: Informational pre-package helper snapshot; exact source hashes authoritative. Canonical Git only introduced -2 package; -1 is the genuine retained earlier candidate, not a published release.
